def transform(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cells=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]]
    if not cells: return [row[:] for row in g]
    rmax=max(r for r,c,_ in cells)
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for r,c,v in cells:
        nc=c-(rmax-r)
        if 0<=nc<W: out[r][nc]=v
    return out
